A.explanation: This puts the radio transmitter first and X-rays last, which is decreasing not increasing wavelength.

B.explanation: This correctly starts with X-rays then red light but swaps the $30 \text{ mm}$ radar and radio waves, even though radio waves have much longer wavelength than microwaves.

C.explanation: X-rays are shortest, then red light at about $650 \text{ nm}$, then $30 \text{ mm}$ microwaves, then radio waves which are longest.

D.explanation: This starts with the $30 \text{ mm}$ radar and ends with X-rays, so it does not go from shortest to longest wavelength.

hints: Notice the four given wavelengths: X-rays for source 2, red light for source 4, $30 \text{ mm}$ for source 3, and radio waves for source 1.
Recall the electromagnetic spectrum order by increasing wavelength: X-rays, then visible light, then microwaves including radar, then radio waves.
Compare the $30 \text{ mm}$ radar wave with red light at about $10^{-7} \text{ m}$ and with radio waves of order metres to place source 3 between sources 4 and 1.
walkthrough: Identify the wave type for each source: 2 is X-rays, 4 is red visible light, 3 is microwave radar with $\lambda = 30 \text{ mm} = 3.0 \times 10^{-2} \text{ m}$, 1 is radio waves.

State the spectrum rule for free space: all travel at $c = 3.0 \times 10^{8} \text{ m s}^{-1}$ and increasing wavelength means decreasing frequency in the order gamma, X-ray, ultraviolet, visible, infrared, microwave, radio.
Place the shortest wavelength first: X-rays have $\lambda$ about $10^{-10} \text{ m}$ to $10^{-8} \text{ m}$, so source 2 is smallest.
Place red light next: red light has $\lambda$ about $6$ to $7 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}$, larger than X-rays but much smaller than $3.0 \times 10^{-2} \text{ m}$, so source 4 is second.
Place the remaining two: $30 \text{ mm}$ microwaves are larger than visible light but smaller than typical radio waves of $1 \text{ m}$ or more, so source 3 comes before source 1.
The increasing wavelength order from left to right is therefore 2 then 4 then 3 then 1. This is option C.
